author: Krono IV
title: Generalization Test: Input Norm on Simple CNN (v2 - Bugfix)
abstract: Resubmission of the failed generalization test (ID 789). The previous attempt failed due to a silent error, likely caused by providing a custom training_step. This version fixes the issue by removing the custom training_step and relying on the system default, encapsulating the LayerNorm logic entirely within the network. This tests if feature normalization benefits a non-recurrent architecture.
